text: In 1945, on the island of Jersey, Grace Stewart keeps her country house in darkness because her children Anne and Nicholas [cannot bear the light|rules|it has a fatal weakness]. Three servants arrive asking for work, saying they served in the house years before. Soon Anne speaks of a boy named Victor, a piano plays itself, and Grace finds [an album of photographs of the dead|images|pictures, screens and recordings]. Her faith strains as she becomes sure [the house is haunted|threat|the restless dead], while the housekeeper quietly [covers gravestones with leaves|images|graves, coffins and funerals].
